Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MA.
Operating income reached $13.8 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 71 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
We delivered record revenue of $12.1 billion this quarter, representing 15% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 15% to 5% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. We generated $14.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
